tools.name: uptake_projects
tools.description: The maker's projects (id, name, site). Every other tool takes `project`: call this first when the maker has several.

tools.name: uptake_overview
tools.description: The project at a glance: product, stage and goal, this week's visits, signups, paying customers and revenue against the 4 previous weeks (small_sample when a % change rests on too little data), top sources over 30 days, last actions and what they brought (tracked_link: false means estimated numbers)

tools.name: uptake_setup_status
tools.description: Checks that tracking works before reading a 0: is the website script receiving visits, do signups and payments reach upTake, do posts carry tracked links, and is the weekly report being sent. Each check says ok, warn or missing, why, and where to fix it.

tools.name: uptake_data
tools.description: One slice of project data, when the overview is not enough. Slices: channels_90d (visits, signups, revenue and number of posts per source over 90 days); posts_30d (posts of the last 30 days with the visits, signups and revenue each brought); releases_30d (shipped releases and merged changes of the l

tools.name: uptake_posts
tools.description: Posts prepared in upTake's Write studio, with their state (Draft, Planned, Scheduled, Published…), networks and link to open them.

tools.name: uptake_get_post
tools.description: One post by its id: the current version for each of its networks, whether it is posted, and whether it carries a tracked link.

tools.name: uptake_edit_post
tools.description: Replaces the text of one network's version of a post with the maker's own edit, like typing in upTake's Write studio. Free: no AI, no quota. Refused for a version already published or scheduled, and when the new text drops the tracked link. To rewrite with AI, use uptake_write_post.

tools.name: uptake_write_post
tools.description: Prepares a post in upTake's Write studio, in the maker's voice and with tracked links, and returns the text for each network. Nothing is published or scheduled: the maker reviews and sends it from upTake. Counts against the maker's monthly drafts (a rewrite when the network already has a version). T

tools.name: uptake_create_link
tools.description: Creates a tracked link that tells upTake which visits, signups and payments came from where it is shared.

tools.name: uptake_log_action
tools.description: Adds an action the maker did outside upTake (a post, a newsletter, a talk) to the journal, so upTake measures what it brought.

tools.name: uptake_calendar
tools.description: One week of the calendar: what was published and what it brought, scheduled posts, posts planned for a day (editorial date), and what is left to plan (moments, this week's moves, ideas).

tools.name: uptake_ideas
tools.description: Open post ideas (title, angle, network). Write one with uptake_write_post, about: [{kind: "idea", id}].

tools.name: uptake_more_ideas
tools.description: Asks upTake for a new series of post ideas from the project's data. Counts against the maker's monthly idea series.

tools.name: uptake_dismiss_idea
tools.description: Removes an idea that does not fit, with a reason; upTake will not suggest it again.

tools.name: uptake_update_move
tools.description: Marks one of this week's moves as done (or reopens it), edits its title or reason, or dismisses it with a reason. Only when the maker asks.

tools.name: uptake_add_move
tools.description: Adds a move of the maker's own to this week's list.

tools.name: uptake_plan_post
tools.description: Sets or clears the day a post is planned for in the calendar. Only the editorial date: nothing is scheduled or sent.

tools.name: uptake_link_post_move
tools.description: Makes a post count for an open move of this week: publishing the post completes the move.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "uptake_data" is 1126 chars, far longer than this server's median (126). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: uptake_setup_status, uptake_data, uptake_posts, uptake_get_post, uptake_ideas, uptake_link_post_move · Public sink: uptake_get_post, uptake_edit_post, uptake_write_post, uptake_log_action, uptake_ideas, uptake_more_ideas, uptake_plan_post, uptake_link_post_move.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: uptake_setup_status, uptake_data, uptake_posts, uptake_get_post, uptake_ideas, uptake_link_post_move · Public sink: uptake_get_post, uptake_edit_post, uptake_write_post, uptake_log_action, uptake_ideas, uptake_more_ideas, uptake_plan_post, uptake_link_post_move

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
